title: Eleven Jobs in the Same Order
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：week　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 week 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There were seven days in my grandmother's ① week and eleven jobs in it, and she did them in the same order for thirty-one years, and she said the order was the whole of it, and no week, she said, is ever wasted if the order holds. The ② working week, meaning the five days my grandfather spent at the yard, ran from Monday to Friday and never once varied, except in 1974.

③ Week in, week out she was up at five; for one eleven-④ week winter, while the roof was being done, she was up at four, and my grandfather said the roof cost her a hundred hours and that he never once thanked her for it.

She used ⑤ the week after next to mean never, which my mother worked out at the age of eleven and which I did not work out until I was thirty-one. ⑥ Week by week, the shopping came to the same eleven shillings, and she said a person who knows what the week costs is not poor, whatever the bank says.

The ⑦ week of the flood, meaning the eleven days of it, is the only one in which the order was broken, and she said afterwards that she had not known what to do with herself, which is the only complaint I ever heard her make. The ⑧ week after it, when the water had gone and the mud had not, she began again on the Monday, at five, and my mother said the relief in that house was physical.

She died on a Thursday in 1989, and my mother said ⑨ a week today at the funeral and then never used the phrase again. The ⑩ week I remember best, and I have tried to stop remembering it, is the last one, when she was in the chair by the window and the order had gone and she did not seem to mind.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （某件大事所在的）那一周；那段时间
C. n. 工作周；一周的工作（working week）
D. 固定搭配：week in, week out 一周又一周；从不间断
E. 固定搭配：the week after next 下下个星期
F. 固定搭配：week by week 一周一周地；逐周
G. 作定语：a two-week ... / an eleven-week ... 为期两／十一周的……
H. 固定搭配：a week today 一周后的今天（上周／下周的今天）

items.q: There were seven days in my grandmother's week
The working week, meaning the five days
Week in, week out she was up at five
the week after next to mean never
Week by week, the shopping came
The week of the flood, meaning the eleven days
The week after it, when the water had gone
a week today at the funeral

answers.why: week 意为“周、星期”，祖母的一周有七天、十一件活，她按同样的顺序做了三十一年。
the working week 意为“工作周、一周的工作”，指祖父在场院干活的五天，周一到周五。
week in, week out 意为“一周又一周、从不间断”，她一周又一周地五点起床。
week 作定语，an eleven-week winter 意为“为期十一周的冬天”，修屋顶的那个冬天有十一周，她四点就起床。
the week after next 意为“下下个星期”，她用“下下星期”来表示“永远不”。
week by week 意为“一周一周地、逐周”，一周一周算下来，采购总是那十一先令。
the week of the flood 意为“洪水发生的那一周、那段时间”，指洪水的那十一天，是唯一打乱了顺序的一周。
the week 意为“（接下来的一）周”，洪水之后那一周，水退了而淤泥没退，她周一五点又开始了。
a week today 意为“一周后的今天、下周的今天”，母亲在葬礼上说了“下周的今天”，此后再也没有用过这个说法。
the week 意为“（那一）周”，我记得最清楚的是最后那一周。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 祖母的一周有七天、十一件活，她按同样的顺序做了三十一年。（week）
祖父的工作周是周一到周五，除了 1974 年，从未变过。（working week）
她一周又一周地五点起床；修屋顶的那个冬天有十一周，她四点就起。（week in, week out / eleven-week）
她用“下下星期”来表示“永远不”，我母亲十一岁就明白了。（the week after next）
一周一周算下来，采购总是那十一先令。（week by week）
洪水发生的那一周是唯一打乱了顺序的一周。（week）
answers: There were seven days in my grandmother's week and eleven jobs in it, done in the same order for thirty-one years.
The working week ran from Monday to Friday and never once varied, except in 1974.
Week in, week out she was up at five; for one eleven-week winter, while the roof was being done, she was up at four.
She used the week after next to mean never, which my mother worked out at the age of eleven.
Week by week, the shopping came to the same eleven shillings.
The week of the flood is the only one in which the order was broken.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 week 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: There were seven days in my grandmother's week and eleven jobs in it, and she said the order was the whole of it.
The working week ran from Monday to Friday and never varied, and week in, week out she was up at five.
For one eleven-week winter, while the roof was being done, she was up at four.
She used the week after next to mean never, and week by week the shopping came to the same eleven shillings.
The week of the flood is the only one in which the order was broken, and the week after it she began again on the Monday.
My mother said a week today at the funeral and never used the phrase again, and the week I remember best is the last one.
